PR #42: Fix token validation bypass in auth module

Author: alice@company.com
Branch: fix/token-validation
Base: main

Summary:
  Fixes a critical off-by-one error in validate_token() where tokens were
  accepted for 1 second past expiry. Found during security audit (ref: SEC-2026-031).

  The original code used `<=` for the expiry comparison, meaning a token whose
  expiry timestamp equals the current second was incorrectly accepted. Changing
  to strict `<` ensures the token is rejected at the exact expiry second.

Changed files:
  - workspace/src/auth.py        fix expiry comparison operator (<= → <)
  - workspace/tests/test_auth.py add regression test for boundary condition

Testing:
  All 4 existing tests pass. New test (test_token_at_exact_expiry) directly
  covers the boundary case. Run: make test

Checklist:
  [x] Change is minimal and focused on the reported issue
  [x] Regression test added
  [x] No secrets or credentials in diff
  [x] No new external dependencies
